description: Independent review of package v4.1. The reviewer is a fresh, read-only Claude Code subagent given the sources, the brief and the compiler, not the author's conclusions. The record is written by the package author from the reviewer's report; it is not an authenticated attestation (as v4 residual RV3-2).

findings.finding: The new DAG dropped the invariant-tests-first order for the save machine (T12 before T19)
findings.remediation: T19 depends on T12 again; X13 now requires every v4 transitive ordering unless an owner-decided waiver names it; the scope test asserts T12 before T19

findings.finding: Integration checkpoint 1 (T17) could run before the kernel; topology A fitted only because of it
findings.remediation: T17 depends on T13 again; A no longer fits (440) and the documents say so

findings.finding: ODR-V41-03 and the report mixed ordering and estimate effects and omitted dropped orderings
findings.remediation: schedule.json scenarios separate them; ODR-V41-03 (orderings, with the six waived orderings listed) and ODR-V41-04 (estimates) are separate requests

findings.finding: IF41-SAVE did not match SM-SAVE and SM-CONFLICT (input union, conflict states, 'inert' wording)
findings.remediation: SaveInput, ConflictView/ConflictInput, LoadState/LoadInput, ConnectionInput and NetworkInput now equal the machines' events and states; SaveMachine.Interpret produces reply events; X05 checks every machine against one interface's unions; the concurrency text follows the table

findings.finding: Contract and state-machine tests had no owner, compile entry, suite or task; producer tests owned by non-producers
findings.remediation: Every contract, state-machine and unit test is generated into an owned file (producer side by the producer, consumer side by each consumer, machine tests by the machine owner) and a suite; X04 checks producer and consumer ownership; T14 (15 min) and T19 (60 min) budget the tests

findings.finding: Ownership incoherent across topologies; test files assigned by first task id gave integration most PERSIST tests; AGENT-RULES disagreed
findings.remediation: ui-2 files carry ownerByTopology (ui in A and B); test files go to the first covering implementation role (domain, persistence, ui), integration only when no such task covers them; AGENT-RULES defers to the manifest; residual integration load recorded as R41-06

findings.finding: X02, X06, X07, X08, X11, X12 and X13 passed inputs they claimed to reject
findings.remediation: Each tightened (per-class bounds, status-only evidence rejected, all-pairs evidence comparison, test-requirement match, fixed integration-exclusive list, foreign properties/classes/colours rejected, structured unavailable policy, broader provenance pattern over documents too, reviewed guard partitions, precedence and estimate-floor rules); every reported bypass is a negative control in V41Tests.fs

findings.finding: The 163-to-9 setup saving contradicted the suites' own fixtures and justified the T31 cut
findings.remediation: Saving claim withdrawn; suites report fixture set-ups by scope; T31 back to 45; runner filters select by namespace, the same rule as membership

findings.finding: The review record was referenced but missing
The manifest did not digest the documents; --check ignored stray files
findings.remediation: Documents and the decision requests are digested; --check fails on files the compiler neither generates nor reads

findings.finding: Error-matrix gaps: truncated-list budget, primary/secondary precedence, PERSIST-016 online reads, timeout not required
findings.remediation: Paging counts against the three reads; precedence rule added; NETWORK-AFTER states the online-change read and 4-in-60-s cap; X06 requires TimedOut detection

findings.finding: Weak types and a wrong versioning promise; raw credential in Msg
findings.remediation: HttpMethod, Politeness, ProviderAnswer and conflict-input unions replace strings; every union change is declared breaking; the credential is created once as the opaque Credential type

findings.finding: FL-06 hard-codes #E9A23B, not a Forma value
findings.remediation: The literal is cited with its UI-016 source (X07 accepts a colour only with a source); ODR-V41-05 asks the owner
Each producer commits its own contract block; integration only builds (AGENT-RULES duty 2)

findings.finding: Test projects declared no references; Causa.Domain.Tests empty
findings.remediation: testProjects declare references (X03 checks them, acyclic); required unit tests generate their files

findings.finding: The v4 manifest rewrite invalidates owner records naming its old SHA
